description: render.ai is an AI platform for generating editable presentations and visual assets from text prompts. It lets users create decks, apply themes, monitor generation, and export results such as PDF, PowerPoint, and Google Slides.
summary: render.ai exposes two developer surfaces on `api.render.ai`: a streamable HTTP MCP server at `/mcp` with OAuth self-onboarding and optional API-key fallback, and a REST API at `/v1` described by an OpenAPI spec and authenticated with an API key.
